name: modelon-impact-clone
description: Browser-based Modelica system modeling & simulation platform (Modelon Impact clone)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/protocol && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
